title: 1.13 Everyone to the Celebration!
unit_outcome: Understand and say short Spanish sentences about people, family members, and what they are doing.
goal: Bring everyone to one family celebration by finding people, connecting the family, following actions, correcting false clues and answering who they are.
grammar_function: All Spanish Unit 1 patterns, in a mission.
speaking_outcome: Answer who the family members are, out loud.

cards.audio_text: Un niño. Una niña. Un hombre. Una mujer.
cards.spanish_translation: A boy. A girl. A man. A woman.
cards.pedagogy_note: Mission beat 01/24: the learner follows one Spanish clue and discovers how the game responds; the completed interaction advances the same family celebration adventure.

audio_assets.text: The celebration is about to start and some guests are still missing. Listen to each Spanish sentence, find the people, and discover what they are doing. At the end you will answer out loud to open the celebration. First we will practise together.

mission_game.instruction_es: Listen and tap the person.

mission_game.instruction_es: Listen to one sentence at a time and tap the person.
